title: 125 Exporting the Fib Class

segments.text: Oops, one little thing we missed in our class of fib right here, we completely forgot to export this component down at the bottom.
So in fib.js, I'm going to go down to the bottom of this file, and outside of that closing curly brace for the class fib, I'll add in export default fib, like so.
Oops, again, my mistake, I apologize for that, but we're good to go now, so let's take a quick break and continue in just a moment.
